column2: ENGLISH
Your sire has accepted you into the coven, yet you have still to receive a proper title from the household's possessions.
I will ask what is my right.
I can wait.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has come to you requesting a formal recognition by granting [From.GetHerHim] rulership over a part of your realm.
Very well.
I shall decide when it is time.
[From.GetFirstName] has granted your wish and bestowed upon you a holding to rule in the name of [From.GetHerHis] coven.
Excellent.
[From.GetFirstName] has denied your wish, berating you for trying to give [From.GetHerHim] commands.
But I deserve this!
Your [GetFromFromRelation] calls for you with a gentle tone, but when you near [FromFrom.GetHerHim] you realize too late that the dark creature has decided to feast upon your blood.
No! Leave me alone!
There truly is nothing more delicious than virgin blood. Your [GetFromRelation] has left the world of the living and joined you as a child of the night.
Good for [From.GetHerHim].
You thought you would share eternity with your lover, but not that you would share your lover with others. This must stop, either it's yours only or nobody's.
Give ultimatum.
I can share...
[From.GetFirstName] is tired of sharing you with your other lovers. Either you pick [From.GetHerHim] and [From.GetHerHim] only to the end of times, or [From.GetSheHe] will leave forever.
Of course I love you only!
There's the door.
[From.GetFirstName] lied to you: [From.GetSheHe] never really loved, [From.GetSheHe] would rather spend [From.GetHerHis] days wrapped in the cold arms of other undead.
I HATE you!
[From.GetFirstName] understood [From.GetHerHis] error and promised you to send all of [From.GetHerHis] other lovers away and be with you to the end of time.
Finally alone!
The vicious [FromFrom.GetFirstName] has managed to charm [FromFrom.GetHerHis] way into convincing your beloved [From.GetFirstName] to leave you for [FromFrom.GetHerHim].
I'll make [FromFrom.GetHerHim] regret it!

The dreaded ring of [From.GetFirstName] now lies within your hands. Through this wicked artifact [From.GetTitledFirstName] has been able to return from death time and again. Legend has it any vampire could master such a power by wearing this trinket.
And it is MINE now.
I will make sure nobody will ever see this thing again.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has wrested control over the powerful Carstein Ring and now rules over [From.GetHerHis] undead hordes backed by its promise of immortality.
I see...

You've studied [Root.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s routine for some time and believe you could hire an agent to slip through to [Root.PlotTarget.GetHerHis] resting place and steal the ring at the right moment...
My co-conspirators will provide...
I'll pay a thief from my own purse...
I know exactly how to get past the guards.
Too risky - I will bide my time.
This might be the right time. A good thief could slip in and steal the ring.
The plot can pay for a good thief.
*Ask the head of the plot for funds*
I know exactly how to get past the guards.
Too risky - I will bide my time.
I'll pay a thief from my own purse...
My co-conspirator, [From.GetTitledName], is asking for funds to hire a thief in order to steal [Root.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring while [Root.PlotTarget.GetHerHim] is resting...
Very well. Pay the thief.
The ring is not worth the price.
Ask [This.GetTitledName] for funds to steal [This.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring
[From.GetTitledName] has sent me the necessary funds to steal [From.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring...
[This.GetTitledName] receives the funds
[From.GetTitledName] has refused to fund the master thief needed to steal [From.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring.
I will pay for it myself!
Forget it.
Inform [This.GetTitledName] that I will not pay
There are no dreams accompanying your rest during daylight, only the stillness of full death, the one true time when you look no different from a corpse.
And yet.. I feel someone's touch...
Steal [This.GetTitledName]'s ring during [This.GetHerHis] rest next month

There are no dreams in your daylight rest, only the stillness of true death, but you can still feel the thief's touch on your hand. By the time you finally wake the wretch has fled, but you have smelled that scent before...
A million deaths for [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]!
There are no dreams in your daylight rest, only the stillness of true death. You feel the thief's touch only when he is long gone, and your ring with him.
My ring! My ring!!!

There are no dreams in your daylight rest, only the stillness of true death, but you can still feel the thief's touch on your hand. Your claws snap at his neck and lift the pathetic mortal off the ground until he whispers, terrified, the name of his employer.
[FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]? So be it.

There are no dreams in your daylight rest, only the stillness of true death, but you can still feel the thief's touch on your hand. Your claws snap at his neck, but the wretched mortal is fast enough to flee, albeit empty-handed.
Who could have sent him?
My co-conspirator, [From.GetTitledName], has let me know that [From.GetSheHe] has finally found a man skilled and brave enough to try and steal [Root.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring for you.
He better not screw this up.
Tell [This.GetTitledName] of the idea to steal [This.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring
[From.GetTitledName] approves of your idea to hire an agent to steal [From.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring.
Make the preparations.
Approve the plan

[From.GetTitledName] has let me know that the plot to steal [From.PlotTarget.GetTitledName]'s ring is proceeding well. The thief will act on [From.PlotTarget.GetHerHim] while [From.PlotTarget.GetSheHe] rests within one month.
Good.
Success! [From.GetTitledName]'s ring is in your hands. Unfortunately, your complicity was discovered.
Good. But... bad.
Success! That thief was really as skilled as he boasted. [From.GetTitledName] has lost [From.GetHerHis] ring and knows nothing of your involvement.
And now...
Failure! [From.GetTitledName] captured the thief and squeezed your name out of him.
This is bad...
Failure! [From.GetTitledName] woke before the thief could steal the ring, but my complicity has not been revealed.
We will just have to try again.
It has been days now, but still no trace of the thief. The wretched scum must have fled who knows where with your ring!
A thousand curses!
The dreaded Red Duke has risen once again to claim his rule over Aquitaine and all of Bretonnia.
Follow me to war, brothers!
I will bide my time...
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has gathered new fledglings to increase the size of [From.GetHerHis] host, bringing prestige to your name.
Good.

In your long quest for perfection you've defeated countless enemies and ravaged entire provinces. In this search, your men collected several trinkets. It is only right to send some of them to the Master of your Order.
They have no value to me anyway.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has quested long and hard, honing [From.GetHerHis] skills in the search for perfection. [From.GetSheHe] has sent part of [From.GetHerHis] spoils of war as tribute in your honour: mostly trinkets, but now and then the blade of a fallen champion worth keeping.
Trinkets.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has tricked you: the fiend is nothing but a Prince of Darkness and has taken [event_target:eloper.GetFirstName] away from you, turning [event_target:eloper.GetHerHim] into an unliving abomination.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has tricked you: the vampire saw something in [event_target:eloper.GetFirstName] and snatched [event_target:eloper.GetHerHim] away from you to make [event_target:eloper.GetHerHim] a fledgling of the Blood Dragons.
[From.GetSheHe] could have asked...
How dare [From.GetSheHe]!
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has found a talented young mortal to join [From.GetHerHis] ranks and turned the human into another knight of the Order.
It better be very talented.

The Blood Dragons have deployed their mindless and relentless servants to permanently occupy the province of [Root.GetName], if the county is not freed soon, a new enemy fortress shall rise within your very borders.
They must be stopped!
The Blood Dragons in [Root.GetName], have completed their work: a dreaded fortress stands within your lands, housing new undead forces.
Damnation!
Just like moths circling towards the light, a band of ghouls and minor undead has shambled its way to your dominion, instinctively seeking the guide of an aristocrat of the night such as yourself.
More servants are always welcome.
Those revolting carcasses are beneath my needs.
You've waited too long. The adventurers and nomadic Strygan tribes gathered under your banner have slowly lost interest and left, leaving you with too few troops to attempt the reconquest.

You've waited too long. The shambling bands of ghouls gathered under your will have devolved into petty infighting out of starvation, tearing each other apart to the point you have too little troops to attempt an invasion.
Next time... next time...
A great caravan comes into your capital, led by several warriors of the Badlands who heard of your plans and have decided to join you on your quest for your old homeland.
Slowly but surely, ghouls have started to flock to your lands, lured by a silent call they cannot resist.
Come.

Your name is well remembered by the old aristocrats of Strygos. Your bloodline is reclusive by nature, yet your renown was enough to lead another Strigoi to your court, ready to pledge allegiance to you and follow you in your conquest.

Your name is well remembered by the old aristocrats of Strygos. Your bloodline is reclusive by nature, yet your renown was enough to lead another Strigoi to your court, ready to pledge allegiance to you and follow you in your conquest.
Welcome, brother.
Little by little, warriors and adventurers have come to your capital, eagerly awaiting the war to reclaim their ancestors' homeland.
Little by little, the ghouls and Strigany come to you, flocking your land and awaiting your command to march against the usurpers of your ancestral realm.
Good.

You never doubted it, you knew this day would have come, you knew you would have been the one to reclaim Strygos. With the core regions firmly under your control, nobody can deny your great empire is nearly restored. The hordes of savage greenskins and the pitiful armies of the mortals or the trickery of the accursed Lahmians could do nothing but slow down the inevitable.\n\n Strygos has returned to life, with you as its rightful monarch.
I am victorious!

Only legends tell of the wonders and the greatness of old Strygos. Never could you have dreamed that one such as yourself would restore the realm of the immortals. And yet here you are, holding the power once held by the court of Ushoran, wrested by your hand from the savage greenskins.\n\nStrygos has risen once more.
A new age starts for our people!

Despite your trickery and plots, the pitiful human descendants of old Strygos have reclaimed their homeland, and one of them has the gall to call [From.GetHerHim]self ruler of that accursed and long-forgotten realm.

For millennia the Lahmians have hindered and hunted down the pathetic remnants of Ushoran's bloodline, and yet the Strigoi have prevailed: a perverted flesh-eater rules over the Badlands, fancying [From.GetHerHim]self monarch of Strygos. Never were you so angered and embarrassed by your failure.
Curse them all!

You had long dreamed of this moment, yet the rebirth of Strygos came from the most unexpected source: not one of Ushoran's bloodline, but a humble mortal, a wandering Strigany, restored the old realm.

You had long dreamed of this moment and, although you wished to be the one to restore Strygos, you find solace knowing the blood of Ushoran reigns once more in Mourkain, demanding proper respect over all the Badlands.
I wish to join this Strygos reborn.
This is but another fleeting dream.
With Strygos reformed, you have the chance to restore the old Kingdom to its true glory. Should you push for the return of the old laws and customs?
Yes, Strygos shall be as it were.
No, this is a new Kingdom.
The Strigany in [Root.GetName] have slowly settled permanently in their old lands, taking the old customs of their forefathers.
Good.
More Strigany are flocking every month in [Root.GetName], colonizing once more their ancestral homeland.
Good.

A great caravan of Strigany has come to the gates of your capital. The gypsies wear strange clothes and speak a strange dialect, but they seem quiet and well-meaning. They bring curious crafts and exotic spices from afar to sell within your walls.
They are welcome.
I don't want their kind here.
[FromFrom.GetFirstName] has returned empty-handed from the expedition. It appears none of the lands [FromFrom.GetSheHe] visited would welcome Strigany merchants.
Drats.

Esteemed [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I bring good tidings from [From.Location.GetName], we've been accepted by the locals and started selling our wares. 

I've sent some of our profit along with this missive
[FromFrom.GetTitledName]
Good.
Your merchants have sold lots of wares and made good profit this season. You will be greatly welcomed as you return to your liege.
Let's ride home, friends.

Esteemed [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I bring you great wealth from [From.Location.GetName], where our merchants have sold most of our wares this season.

As is customary, I send you your share of the profits.
[From.GetTitledName]
Good. Keep travelling there.
This will be enough for that place. I want you here.
The Strigany merchants have packed their tents and removed themselves from your capital, probably for good this time.
It was about time.
Your merchants have sold some wares and made a decent profit this season. You will be welcomed as you return to your liege.
Let's ride home, friends.

Esteemed [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I bring you wealth from [From.Location.GetName], where our merchants have sold a good part of our wares this season.

As is customary, I send you your share of the profits.
[From.GetTitledName]
Good. Keep travelling there.
This will be enough for that place. I want you here.
A series of accidents and misunderstandings has earned you the hatred of the locals, and the season brought little profit.
Drats.

There has been some discontent in your capital in the past few months. The locals have grown tired of the Strigany wandering about their homes, taking up their places in the market and, according to some reports, performing dark rituals in the night.
Those gypsies are nothing but trouble.

Esteemed [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I regret to inform you our travel to [From.Location.GetName] has not been as successful as expected. A series of accidents and misunderstandings have earned us the hate of the locals, making it difficult for our merchants to sell their wares. 

Perhaps it might be better to change our destination for the next season
[From.GetTitledName]
No, keep travelling there. They'll get used to us.
A good suggestion. Stay here for now.
The bigotry and hate of the locals drove them to openly attack your merchants. You are forced to return home without any of your products sold.
Curses.

The people in the capital have grown tired of the Strigany. Made fearful by their strange customs and dark rituals, they've risen up and openly attacked the merchants, driving them away from your city.
Probably it's for the best...

Esteemed [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I regret to inform you our travel to [From.Location.GetName] has been ill-fated. The locals, enflamed by our mere appearance, have driven us out of the city in a few days, preventing us from selling any of our wares. 

We are no longer welcomed in this realm for some time,
[From.GetTitledName]
That's inconvenient.
Your skill as a leader and a merchant has turned your caravan into a proper settlement in these lands.
Great!

Your leniency in the past years might have been ill-advised. The community of Strigany has become so large to have claimed some of your lands, building a stable tribe there from which their caravans pass through each season.
That's... not something I ordered.

Esteemed [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Our perseverance has paid off. No longer are we mere travellers in [From.Location.GetName]: a lasting Strigany outpost has been built in the past years as more of our people came to share in our profits.

We pledge ourselves to your protection as I take charge of this post, with your blessing,
[From.GetTitledName]
Great news indeed.
Your minions have broken the defenses of [From.GetName]. Even now they move forward to round up the local population. What should be done with the mortals?
Kill them all. Destroy everything.
They'll make good subjects.
I do not care about these.
[From.GetFirstName] has sent [From.GetHerHis] vile minions to destroy the province of [FromFrom.GetName], leaving nothing but tainted rubble, marked with the repulsive stench of undeath.
Blasted abominations!
[From.GetFirstName] has sent [From.GetHerHis] vile minions to destroy the province of [FromFrom.GetName], kidnapping dozens of families to be subjected to [From.GetHerHis] vile experiments.
Blasted abominations!
[From.GetFirstName] has sent [From.GetHerHis] vile minions to destroy the province of [FromFrom.GetName], many of the survivors of the attack are already flocking your gates.
Blasted abominations!
You have some spare subjects in your dungeons. How would you employ them?
They are good samples for my personal studies.
They can be repurposed to serve me forever.
Keep them there for now.

As the blood of the last subject runs dry, you have concluded one of the most successful sessions of study you've had in quite some time. Experimenting on the pitiful mortals has given you a deeper understanding of the dark art of Nagash.
Another good night of work.

Subject after subject, you twist and break the bodies and souls of your victims, studying their entrails, recording the pitch of their screams, trying and dispelling one incantation after another. In the end, you are satisfied with your results.
Another good night of work.

Subject after subject, you twist and break the bodies and souls of your victims, looking at their entrails, recording the pitch of their screams, trying and dispelling incantations one after the other. The results might not be as good as you hoped for, but you're still adequately satisfied with yourself.
Another good night of work.

Subject after subject, you twist and break the bodies and souls of your victims, looking at their entrails, recording the pitch of their screams, trying and dispelling incantations one after the other. Sadly, this batch of mortals was not as enlightening as one would have hoped and your night ends in mild frustration.
Next time will be better.

Once you're done with them, the resulting minions have no resemblance to the subjects they once were. Such was the power and the skill you put on your work, they've been utterly transformed into loyal and terrifying creatures of the night.
Magnificent.

You've had to discard several damaged subjects, but those who survived have now no resemblance to the subjects they once were. Such was the power and the skill you put on your work, they've been utterly transformed into loyal and terrifying creatures of the night.
Magnificent.

Your original draft might have been too ambitious or, more likely, your subjects defective. The result of your experiment was a pack of ravenous and gibberish humanoids, still useful in a way, but nothing as grand and terrifying as you hoped for.
Next time.

Your original draft might have been too ambitious or, more likely, your subjects defective. None of them managed to stay alive until the end. They'll at least be decent undead slaves, if nothing else.
Better than nothing.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has sent some of [From.GetHerHis] minions pleading for you to put your vast magical expertise into [From.GetHerHis] temporary employ and craft a magic item for [From.GetHerHim].
Very well.
I do not make trinkets for the likes of you.
[From.GetFirstName] has decided it would not be in [From.GetHerHis] best interest to craft a magic item for you.
Drats.
The poison of the Dragon-Emperor is drying your blood. As more and more time passes since you've stared into the Dark Crystal, you feel your mind slipping into madness and your body collapsing.
I will gaze into the Jade.
I don't need help!

You slither into the dark room and your eyes are soon caught by the sickly green glow of the black sphere standing on the pedestal. You are drawn closer to it and stare for days at its dark and smooth surface, letting its unholy power refill your body.
I am reborn!
It took you a while to notice, but some precious artifacts have disappeared from your treasury. Your servants swear you ordered them shipped to an unknown place days ago.
Grmmmhhh...
There is an important matter that requires your attention. You're uncertain how long it will take, but you feel compelled to depart immediately, alongside your servants.

In your meditation your gaze cut through the veil of the Dark Crystal itself. You saw the slopes of the Imperial City, the seat from which the Heavenly Dragons rule over their subjects. Your will truly is divine, for you caught a glimpse of their power and made it yours.
I command the Heavensss!

You stared deeply into the Dark Crystal and as your power was restored, you glimpsed beyond its veil at wonders beyond the understanding of mortals. There is much to be learned from these ancient artifacts and you are one step closer to unlock their secrets.
The sssound of the universe...

You stared deeply into the Dark Crystal and as your power was restored, you glimpsed beyond its veil and saw the lair of the Firebringer. Wandering in the dreams of the ancient dragon, you stared at his works and new wonders were unlocked in your mind as well.
Cogs and contraptions...
You stared for too long in the poisonous depths of the Dark Crystal. The flow of forbidden knowledge bursts through your body, leaving you wrecked on the ground.
You stared for too long in the poisonous depths of the Dark Crystal. The flow of forbidden knowledge whips your mind, merging thoughts and stealing memories.
Aaahhh!!

You stared for too long in the poisonous depths of the Dark Crystal. The flow of forbidden knowledge overwhelms your mind, distorting your perceptions and breaking your senses. You leave the room screaming nonsense and pulling your hair off.
The great wyrms see me!!!
You stared too long into the poisonous depths of the Dark Crystal. The flow of forbidden knowledge bursts through your body, consuming your mind and turning your flesh into a searing light.
AaaaaAAAAHHH!!!

You starved yourself in your meditation, staring in the depths of the Dark Crystal. In these past days you've seen wondrous and terrible things that you would have never believed in before. You've seen the real gods in their Heavenly Palace across the clouds, there is no denying they are the only creatures worthy of service.
For henceforth I pledge myself to the Heavenly Dragons!

You've spent days gazing into the Dark Crystal and you've seen glimpses of the shining coils of the Dragon-Gods. Zan Long, the Ordainer, the one who determines the tasks and castes, has shared with you a fraction of his ancient knowledge, granting you preternatural eloquence.
I am honored by his gift.

You've spent days gazing into the Dark Crystal and you've seen glimpses of the shining coils of the Dragon-Gods. Yein, the Heavenly Sibling of Conquest, has opened your mind to memories of ancient battles on the grounds and skies of the Fabled Cathay, granting you a deeper insight on the battlefield.
I'll put this knowledge to good use.

You've spent days gazing into the Dark Crystal and you've seen glimpses of the shining coils of the Dragon-Gods. Zan Long, the Ordainer, has guided you to the gates of the Celestial Palace and showed you some fragments from the scrolls upon which the laws of the Heavens were written.
I see all so clearly!

Your search inside the sickly reflections of the Dark Crystal has led you into somber and cold places. You've seen the great lair of the Sleeping One, Xao Saen, oldest of the Heavenly Dragons, and he has shared fragments of his dreams with you, showing you long-forgotten secrets and tricks.
A great gift to keep.

You've spent days gazing into the Dark Crystal and you've seen glimpses of the shining coils of the Dragon-Gods. The unending spires of the Heavenly City unravel around you as you float beneath the shadow of Fa Xeng, the Firegiver and most beloved amongst the Cathayans. His mere sight is enough to unlock the potential of your mind.
So much knowledge...

You've spent days gazing into the Dark Crystal and you've seen glimpses of the shining coils of the Dragon Gods. Yet it is in the night and a thick fog that you see the divine eyes of Xen Huong, Judge of Life and Fate. In the reflection of the Dragon-Emperor's terrible eyes you see what lies before you and know that you are blessed.

In the dark reflections of the crystal you have found peace and clarity of mind. The glimpse you caught of the slopes of the Heavens built by the Dragon Gods has quieted the voices and restored your sanity.
The wicked taint of Chaos could not bear the poisonous light of the Dark Crystal. As you gazed into it, the corrupted flesh melted away, cleansing your body of the touch of the Warp.
Your mission brought you far away from your palace, but it's finally over and you feel free to return to the usual business.
Good.
Your mission took you far from your palace and into many dangerous places. When you come to your senses you are in an unknown land, grievously injured, and you barely make it home.
Rrrgh...
Your mission brought you far away from your palace and to many dangerous places and revealed itself to be too much for you to handle.

[FromFrom.GetFirstName] wraps [FromFrom.GetHerHis] coils around you and stares into your eyes, slowly hissing. The unflinching reptilian stare of the Jade pierces into your mind, trying to bend it to [FromFrom.GetHerHis] will.
Must.. resist..!
The Jade have fed aplenty upon the worthless inhabitants of [Root.GetName]. So many have been taken that servants and workers are now rare and the work there has slowed.
How long before those insssects breed some more?
The insufferable mortals in [Root.GetName] still oppose your dominion over them. The endless resistance to the Jade's many feasts has further inflamed them.
They'll learn, one way or another.

Is it time once more to feast over the flocks of unworthy mortals, rounding them up, relocating some for further breeding and suck the rest dry in a orderly fashion, as dictated by the rituals of the Imperial Scribe?
Yesss, let us proceed...
Not yet.

No city, fortress or village is left untouched. The swarms of Jade vampires circle the province, tightening their coils on every inhabitant they can find: some are bled dry, the most promising are turned and the rest are taken to their palaces as pets and slaves.
The rituals have been upheld.

No city, fortress or village is left untouched. The swarms of Jade vampires circle the province, tightening their coils on every inhabitant they can find: some are bled dry, the most promising are turned and the rest are taken to their palaces as pets and slaves. The land lies empty now.
We'll send the lizardss to fill the void sssoon...

This province seems to offer more resistance than others. Villages have been abandoned before your arrival, villagers attack your guards, try to ambush you during the day, soon you discover this feast has turned into an uprising against your just rule.
To armsss!
[FromFromFrom.GetName] has been empty for some time, but you have finally spared enough Saurus to set up a garrison of sorts there.
Until they are also required to sate our thirst...
You've broken the defenses of [From.GetName], this province is filled with healthy cattle and several Jade are eager to take their due from the conquered population.
Have at it.
Not here!

The merciless undead of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have come to your lands and slaughtered your people. Soldier or commoner is of no difference for them and the few who have not been sucked dry have been enslaved and deported to their mysterious palaces.
Monsters!

The merciless undead of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have come to [FromFrom.GetName] and slaughtered its people. Soldier or commoner is of no difference for them and the few who have not been sucked dry have been enslaved and deported to their mysterious palaces.
Monsters!

You've been searching for it for centuries and now you can bask once more in the greenish light of its dark surface. A Dark Crystal for you to stare at once more, to look at the Heavens as you did when you were there, so many centuries ago, and hear the thundering commands of the Dragon Gods.

No longer will your perfect form be ravaged by the twisted curse of the humans: you've found one of the lost Dark Crystals. Through it, you can tap once more in the power of the Heavens and snatch away what is rightfully yours from the greedy pawns of the Celestial Dragons.

This is a day of celebrations. After many generations of search, you've found one of the lost Crystals of the Heavens. This relic will bring much honor to your family and endear the Celestial Dragons to your cause.

You've spent years searching for it and now it is finally within your grasp: one of the ancient Dark Crystals of Cathay. The fabled jade stone is smooth and pitch black, but a sickly green halo surrounds it, vibrant of the power contained within.
Mine at last!
News have reached you, that [From.GetTitledFirstName] has found one of the fabled Dark Crystals.
I see...

You lose yourself in the dark reflections of the crystals and soon the voices of the Celestial Dragons thunder inside your mind. You must go further with your sacred duty. For your survival and renewed fealty to the Celestial Throne, you have been given command of a new expedition, which will soon reach your colony. It is your task to push further into Lustria and vanquish the interlopers who would disrupt the delicate work of the Heavenly Dragons by reshaping the earth to their twisted needs.
So I shall.

It is hard to see the will of the Celestial Dragons, but surely you must have pleased them by eradicating the legacy of the Imperial Scribe and in reconquering the Dragon Isles in their honor.\n They must be pleased with you, for Xen Huong has sent another great army, so that you might expand Cathay's colonial dreams of conquest even further West.
And so it shall.

Word has come that the former Imperial Scribe has reached the Heavenly City. The wretched renegade entered its sacred gates, never to leave them again. Nobody knows what judgement Xen Huong passed upon him, but you are certain this is the last you will hear of Shdroi So'sou.
After so many centuries, justice is served.
Sadly, the corrupted Jade had still enough power to charm his guards and slither away at the moment of your triumph. Shdroi So'sou has escaped justice once more and plots again for your destruction.
Curses!
You've broken the Law of Heavens, you no longer care about the edicts of the Dragon-Emperor. Thus, crawl in the darkness, for you shall nevermore set coil peacefully in the Celestial Palace.
Ssso be it.
Oi, Bozz! Sumfhin'z wrong! Da zpiderz iz all mad at uz! Maybbe we'z goin' da wrong way?
We don't go here, not makez da Zpider God angry!
Ya git! Da zpiderz bring luck!
The signs you sent were enough to scare the meddling greenskins away. They will not dare to linger near the Shadowlands for some time.

We keep watch through the day.
Let them come. We sleep.

At noon the doors burst open and sunlight floods in. The hunters come: a grim band of mortals with stakes, silver-edged blades and blessed torches, led by a Witch Hunter in a wide-brimmed hat. But you were waiting for them.

You wake to sunlight on your face and the smell of burning. The doors have been thrown open and the chapel roof is on fire. A grim band of mortals with stakes and silver stands in the doorway, led by a Witch Hunter in a wide-brimmed hat who reads aloud from a holy book.
Cut them down!
Flee into the sun!
The hunters lie dead in the ruined chapel, their stakes broken, their holy book trampled into the dust. Their captain still breathes, pinned beneath your boot and spitting prayers at you.
Their blood is still warm. Drink.
Hang them from the crossroads as a warning to the next ones.

A lone knight waits on the road ahead, a grail embroidered on his surcoat and his lance lowered. He is a Questing Knight of the Lady, and he has heard of you. He calls you out to single combat, in the name of the Lady and in the old way.

A knight in full plate bars the road ahead, the blazing sun of his Order on his shield. He has hunted you for weeks, he says, and now he calls you out to single combat before Sigmar and all who watch.

A Kislevite boyar sits his horse across the road, a great axe across his saddle and a winged lancer's banner behind him. He has heard of the dead knight who hunts the steppe, and he calls you out, laughing, to single combat.
A champion of these lands bars the road ahead, alone and unafraid. Word of your host has spread before you, and he calls you out to single combat, for the glory of killing a Blood Dragon.
A worthy foe at last. I accept.
I have no time for this.

The duel is long and hard, and for a moment the champion's blade bites deep. But at last you knock it aside and run your opponent through. Your knights cheer as you raise the head of the fallen champion. Abhorash would have been proud.

The champion is better than you thought. Blow by blow your opponent drives you back, until a strike lands that you cannot turn aside. You fall. Your knights are already reaching for their blades, but the champion steps back, satisfied, and rides off into the dusk.
Perfection is closer.
Next time.

Weeks pass in the dark hold of a black ship, far from the sun and from any foe. Then the crew grows uneasy. Something huge follows in the deep, and at night its back breaks the surface beside the hull.
Stay below decks. We fight on land.
Harpoons! Let us see what it is made of.
The vampires of your court and your vassals are called to ride with you. Every few months the quest rides on and meets a new foe.
Trophy of a Worthy Foe
The skull of the finest foe a Blood Dragon met on the Blood Quest, polished and bound in red iron and worn at the saddle. Every knight of Abhorash who sees it knows what it cost.
Sated
This vampire fed deeply on the Blood Quest.

You are the Queen of the Lahmians. Your ancient city of Lahmia in Nehekhara was taken from you, but its old glories can still be restored. With stealth, cunning and seduction you can mould the world of men to serve you. Send your daughters into the world, have them slip into the corridors of power, and when the time is right, have your mortal puppets dance to your tune. Make slaves of weak mortals, and one day you shall lead a great army to retake Lahmia and live forever as its queen, with nothing in the world denied to you.
So let it be written, so let it be done!

You have chosen [lahmia_new_mark.GetTitledName] as the focus of your efforts. Who shall you send to bend him to the will of the Sisterhood? Only a daughter of your blood or one of your elite agents is skilled enough to seduce so powerful a man.
I will send one of my daughters.
I will send an elite agent of the Sisterhood.
On second thought, not yet.
Your queen has ordered you to seduce [lahmia_new_mark.GetTitledName] and bend him to the will of the Sisterhood. You must leave at once.
You have decided to seduce [lahmia_new_mark.GetTitledName] yourself. He will have no choice but to become your slave and do all that you require of him...
I shall pack my finest gowns, perfumes and jewels at once, my Queen.
Ready my baggage train... and my slaves!
You have arrived in the lands of [lahmia_mark.GetTitledName] in the guise of a rich heiress, with your handmaidens and a house rented in the best quarter of the city. Now... how shall you begin?
I will play the damsel in distress...
I will host a lavish ball as the rich new heiress in town.
With his wife dead, he will need some comforting...
This game is not worth the candle. I will go home.
My mark is dead. It is time to go home.
My Queen, the mark has died. There is nothing more for me to do here, and I shall return home at once.\n\n[From.GetFirstName]
These mortals... such frail and brief lives...
One morning while falconing, you hear a lady scream in the distance. She sounds like she is in serious trouble! You look around, and your companions are nowhere to be seen. What do you do?
I shall rescue the lady!
If she is in trouble, I could be in danger. Ride for home at once!

You hear that your mark is going falconing, and your handmaidens make sure his companions are... distracted. Once you see him alone in the distance you give the signal, and three hired ruffians pretend to attack you as you let out an ear-piercing scream. Just as planned, your mark comes riding at full gallop with his sword drawn, just as the ruffians throw you to the ground. At the sight of him they scatter, and he leaps from his horse to ask if you are hurt.
Oh, my brave lord! You saved my life!

You hear that your mark is going falconing, and your handmaidens make sure his companions are... distracted. Once you see him alone in the distance you give the signal, and three hired ruffians pretend to attack you as you let out an ear-piercing scream. You see your intended staring, hesitating, even as the ruffians throw you to the ground. Then the coward turns and rides away at full speed! Useless, weak, thrice-cursed mortal fool!
*hiss* I will need time to think of a new plan...

As you charge at them with your sword drawn, the ruffians scatter. The lady is beautiful and, judging by her torn gown and jewels, very rich. She thanks you profusely, and you escort her back to the city. There she takes her leave, but promises to repay you for your gallantry.
What a stunning beauty. And I am a hero for saving her!

You played the noble damsel in distress perfectly, letting him see himself as your saviour and protector as he escorted you back to the city. At the market you took your leave with a promise to reward him for his gallantry. What next?
Now I will invite him to a ball in his honour...
First I should get rid of his wife...

Word around the city is that a rich heiress is hosting a magnificent ball, and of course your invitation arrived this very morning in gold-stamped letters. Rumour says she is as beautiful as she is rich. Will you attend?
Why yes, of course! Next week? Certainly.
It is the lady I saved while falconing! Of course I will attend.
No, I have no interest in balls or heiresses.

Tonight is the night of your ball. Everything has been prepared to the finest detail, and you are the centre of attention and envy in the room. At last your prize guest arrives, and the evening unfolds exactly as you wished. The music plays, the nobles dance, the wine flows. You dance with your guest of honour and work your arts on him, subtly. As the evening draws to a close, it is time to make your move...
Whisper in his ear and suggest he stay the night.
Poison his wife. His grief will make him vulnerable.

Tonight is the night of the grand ball. You arrive at a splendid mansion and are greeted by the beautiful, and obviously fabulously wealthy, heiress. As the wine flows and the music plays, your eyes are drawn to her again and again, and often you find her smiling back at you from across the room. When the last dance is called she glides over and leads you to the floor. After a flawless dance she whispers hotly in your ear: 'Care to stay the night, my lord?'
*whisper back* I will return when the guests have left...
No, that would not be proper, my lady. Good night.

You seduce [lahmia_mark.GetFirstName] into a night of wild passion, and as dawn is about to break you know that, for now at least, he is under your spell. While he remains so, you can use your influence once a year to have him send you rich gifts, or even troops on the pretext that your distant family lands are threatened by greenskins or vampires. Should you leave him and return home, however, your hold over him will be lost.

You seduce [lahmia_mark.GetFirstName] into a night of wild passion, and as dawn is about to break you know that, for now at least, he is under your spell. While he remains so, you can use your influence once a year to have him send you rich gifts, or even troops on the pretext that your distant family lands are threatened by greenskins or vampires. You will pass these on to your queen, to further the cause of restoring ancient Lahmia to the Sisterhood. Should you leave him and return home, however, your hold over him will be lost.
I knew he would not resist me.

You have spent a night of wild passion with this beautiful and mysterious lady, and you are certain you will see much more of her in the months and years to come. You have scratches and bite marks all over your body, and though it hurts to get dressed, you leave with a smile on your face.
Until next time, mysterious lady.
Cruel fate! Your wife suddenly took ill and died screaming in the night. It happened so fast... but the physicians found no trace of poison, and who would have a motive?
Cruel fate! When you wake the morning after the ball, your wife lies dead beside you. It happened so quietly... but the physicians found no trace of poison, and who would have a motive?
Why, gods, why?!
These are perilous times...
A plot to poison your wife has been uncovered! Put to the question, the servants caught with the poison confessed everything: a beautiful, rich heiress seduced them into the dark deed...
Your wife has been poisoned, but thanks to the quick actions of a priest she was saved in time! It must have happened at the ball...
I want this 'heiress' seized and executed!
I want everyone who attended questioned at once!

Hah! The mark's wife died 'suddenly and tragically'... what a shame. Your spies at court say no one knows why. Those servant boys you seduced did very well indeed. That is one obstacle removed. Now... on with the plan.

From one of your rings you tipped poison into the cup of your mark's wife just as the last toast was made. She died quietly in her sleep, and the cause remains a mystery. That is one obstacle removed. Now... on with the plan.
What shall be the next step?

Damnation! The foolish servant boys you seduced got themselves caught trying to poison your mark's wife, and your sources at court say they spoke your name. This game of cat and mouse is over. Time to flee.

Damnation! Your sources at court say the place is in uproar. A holy priest saved the wife's life, and now everyone who attended the ball will be closely examined. As a vampire, you cannot pass such an examination... This game of cat and mouse is over. Time to flee.

For all your efforts, your mark has slipped from your grasp. He no longer answers your letters, and the guards at his gates will not admit you any more. There is nothing for it but to give up the chase and go home.
Your mark refuses the bait. He has sent word that he will not attend your ball, and every attempt to reach him since has failed. There is nothing for it but to give up the chase and go home.

Your mark looked at you in shock when you asked him to stay the night, and coldly told you it would not be proper. He left in a hurry, and every attempt to reach him since has failed. This chase is over. It is time to go home.
Curses! Your mark is not so easily led after all. He refuses you money, which makes him useless to you. All that work wasted... it is time to go home.
Curses! Your mark is not so easily led after all. He refuses you troops, which makes him useless to you. All that work wasted... it is time to go home.
I only hope my queen will forgive my failure.
I cannot believe I failed...

The shock of your wife's death still haunts you, but your new lady friend has been a great help and comfort. You find yourself thinking of her all the time. Perhaps it would not be wrong to let this go a little further?
Yes, surely it was meant to be!
No. There is something 'off' about her...

You have played the trusted friend to your mark since his wife's death, and one night, after a great deal of wine, he leans in to kiss you. Hah! Your arts are as strong as ever. He never had a chance...
All men are weak, if you only know which strings to pull.
My Queen, I have failed you. The mark resisted my seduction and will be of no use in gaining us gold or troops.\n\n[From.GetFirstName]
Failure is not an option, my dear...
You disappoint me, daughter.
My Queen, I send you these gifts. I have manipulated my mark into giving me gold to keep up my lifestyle.\n\n[From.GetFirstName]
Well done, daughter.
Well done, daughter. Come home when you are able.

My Queen, I send you these troops. I have manipulated my mark into sending them to protect a dear elderly relative of mine. I trust you will soon turn them into loyal servants of the Sisterhood.\n\n[From.GetFirstName]
Well done, daughter. We look forward to breaking them in.
Well done, daughter. Come home when you are able.

You have woven yourself deeper into the high society around your mark, hosting lavish midnight balls and building your own web of spies, where your handmaidens seduce and manipulate the lesser players while you call the tune. [lahmia_mark.GetFirstName] is in the palm of your hand and will refuse you nothing. What shall you ask for? Perhaps your money is tied up in some venture and you need gold to keep up appearances. Or perhaps a dear relative has lands under threat and could use some soldiers?
Manipulate him into giving me gold.
Manipulate him into giving me troops.
I must go home.

At one of her lavish midnight balls, your dear lady friend, stunning as ever, asks to speak to you privately. She is distraught and close to tears. Her steward has tied up her money in a risky venture, and unless she finds funds elsewhere she cannot keep her estate. She would be humiliated, thrown out of her home and forced to live like a commoner. She looks at you, pleading. Can you do anything to help?
My dear lady, let it trouble you no longer. I will help.
No, I will not help with money.
Your benefactor agrees to support you from his own coffers until your money is free again, and you make sure he is well rewarded for his generosity.
This game is still a delight! Now to send this to my queen.
This game is still a delight!

Your dear lady friend is delighted, and over the following days and weeks you are richly rewarded for your generosity. You are pleased with yourself. The city would be so dull without her beauty, her lavish parties and her clever wit. She truly is the heart of high society.
I could not let such a noble lady live like a commoner...
I could not let such a noble lady be distraught.
You refused to help the heiress with money and left her ball despite her pleas. The next day you hear that she has packed up and left the city.
You refused to send the heiress troops and left her ball despite her pleas. The next day you hear that she has packed up and left the city.
A shame. I think I will miss her.

At one of her lavish balls, your dear lady friend, stunning as ever, asks to speak to you privately. She is distraught and close to tears. A dear elderly aunt has lands under threat, and she does not know how to help her. She looks at you, pleading. Are you powerful enough to send some troops to her aid?
I will send an expedition at once to clear her lands!
No, I will not send troops.
Your benefactor agrees to send troops to protect your endangered relative, and you make sure he is well rewarded for his generosity.
This game is still a delight! Now to send them to my queen.
This game is still a delight!

One night, alone with your lover, she smiles darkly and bares sharp fangs, and grips you with inhuman strength so you cannot run. She is a vampire! Who could have foreseen it? She wants you to come with her to the Lahmian court, where you may be granted eternal life and great power... Do you dare refuse?
Never!
Eternal life and power, you say? Why, of course, my love...

One night, alone with your mortal plaything, you smile darkly, bare your fangs and pin him down so he cannot run. You ask him to join you at the Lahmian court, where he may be granted eternal life and great power. When the shock subsides, you see that he will do as you say. The promise of power and an eternity of delights has swayed his weak mind. His strange disappearance means his family will disinherit him, but if he has any claims, you can press them by war if you wish.
Excellent...

One night, alone with your mortal plaything, you smile darkly, bare your fangs and pin him down so he cannot run. You ask him to join you at the Lahmian court, where he may be granted eternal life and great power. When the shock subsides, you see that he will not. He tears himself away and screams for the guards. What do you do?
Attack him!
*hiss* Weak fool! *leap from the window and run*

You think you have found a mark: [lahmia_recruit_mark.GetTitledName], who is said to be as beautiful as she is skilled in intrigue. She might make a fine addition to the Sisterhood. Shall you seek her out?
Yes, by all means.
No, she is not worthy.

A mysterious lady has drawn you into her confidence over many weeks. Tonight, in a candlelit room, she reveals what she is: one of the Lahmian Sisterhood, ageless and beautiful forever. She offers you the blood kiss, and a place among her sisters. You would have to leave your home and family and never look back.
Yes. Make me one of you.
No! Get away from me!
Through seduction, intimidation and circumstances arranged just so, you convince [From.GetFirstName] to accept the blood kiss and join the Lahmian Sisterhood. Your queen will be very pleased...
Excellent.

For all your efforts, you never get close enough to your mark to give her the blood kiss. Curses! All that time wasted... but she was too well guarded, and there was no sense in risking your life to turn her.
There will be other marks...
My Queen, I have sired a new Lahmian daughter. She is both beautiful and highly skilled, and I trust she will make us proud and serve the Sisterhood well.\n\n[From.GetFirstName]
Well done. You are a good servant.
Your [GetFromRelation] has run off, it seems, leaving her home and family behind. Why would she do such a thing? What could have tempted her to give up everything she had?
Scandalous... she is cut off!
Poor girl, she had so much promise.

One morning you wake alone, with a note on your wife's pillow. It coldly says that she is leaving you, and that you must not look for her or think of her any more. 'All we had is dead, as I am dead. Marry another,' it ends.
Thrice-cursed harlot! She has humiliated me!
Your hidden houses in the realms of men have sent you this year's profits. Whether from brothels, blackmail, assassinations or simple corrupt dealings, they have turned a tidy profit, it seems.
Well done, sisters.
Do not bother me with this again. Just send the money.

There have been strange goings-on in [lahmia_house.GetName]. Young men vanish after the masked balls in a certain house, and those who come back are pale and listless. The temple suspects a hidden nest of vampires, and it must be rooted out with fire and sword.
Our faith will prevail!
No, it is probably nothing...
You have survived the vampires' efforts to stop you. Now that you know where they are, the nest in [lahmia_house.GetName] is rooted out with fire, stakes and cold silver.
Our faith prevails again!
One of your hidden houses has been destroyed by witch hunters. Perhaps it is time to appoint better Protectors? It is their duty to prevent such things!
Curses!
Do not bother me with such bad news again!
Whispers of Vampires
People here whisper of pale ladies and young men who vanish after masked balls. Any witch hunter who comes looking already has one trail to follow.

One evening [vamp_sire.GetTitledFirstName] comes for you with a retinue of guards. 'It is time,' your vampire overlord says, 'for you to join me in the darkness.' There is no escape now, and no choice.

When you meet [vamp_sire.GetFirstName] in [vamp_sire.GetHerHis] chambers, the reason for the summons becomes clear: your friend wishes to make you [vamp_sire.GetHerHis] thrall, so that your friendship may last forever.

You meet [vamp_sire.GetFirstName] under the pale moon, and before [vamp_sire.GetSheHe] can speak you know what [vamp_sire.GetSheHe] will ask: your lover wishes you to share [vamp_sire.GetHerHis] love for all eternity.
Your spouse [vamp_sire.GetFirstName] has called you to [vamp_sire.GetHerHis] chambers and orders you to lie down. It seems [vamp_sire.GetSheHe] has decided to honour you with the dark gift.
Kiss me!
I will never be like you!
No! Get away from me!
An even chance to escape into exile, better for the quick and strong. If you are caught, you are turned.
[From.GetFirstName] wakes in the cold dark, hungry. Another loyal thrall has joined the ranks of the undying.
Excellent.
Word reaches you that [From.GetFirstName], your chosen recipient for the dark gift, has fled your realm rather than become a vampire.
Faithless coward!
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has refused your gift and sends word: 'I will fight to the death rather than bow to your eternal curse!'
So be it! You will serve me in death then!
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstName] has asked you for the dark gift, and swears eternal fealty if you would grant this heartfelt wish.
Your friend [From.GetFirstName] has asked you for the dark gift, wishing to follow and serve you beyond death itself.
Your lover [From.GetFirstName] has asked you for the dark gift, wishing to share your love for eternity.
Your spouse [From.GetFirstName] has asked you for the dark gift. [From.GetSheHe] cannot bear the thought of death ending your bond and leaving you alone.
First death, then eternal life, my new minion...
No, that one is not worthy.
Your [GetFromRelation] bestows the dark gift upon you, and bids you serve [From.GetHerHim] faithfully until the end of days.
The bonds of friendship will outlast the fickle span of life, at least for you and [From.GetFirstName]. Your friend has granted you the dark gift.
Death shall not part you and [From.GetFirstName]. Once [From.GetSheHe] gives you [From.GetHerHis] dark blessing, you wake as a creature of the night, to be at [From.GetHerHis] side forever.
Love will conquer death itself. [From.GetFirstName] has given you the dark kiss, and you are bound together as undying souls, sharing your passion forever.
I live... forever!
Your liege refuses your request, saying you are not worthy. Your skills are lacking, and you are far too unimpressive to join the illustrious ranks of the vampire aristocracy.
Ouch.
Your sire [vamp_sire.GetTitledFirstName] has decided to formally welcome you into [vamp_sire.GetHerHis] bloodline and dynasty.
I welcome this great honour.
I have no wish to join this bloodline.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has gracefully accepted your offer and joined your ancient coven, taking your bloodline as [From.GetHerHis] own.
As [From.GetSheHe] should have.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has refused to take [From.GetHerHis] place within your coven, staining your reputation.
A fledgling defying [Root.GetHerHis] sire?!
One of your fledglings, [vamp_fledgling.GetFirstName], has come to you asking to join your coven fully and be recognised as a member of your ancient bloodline.
We accept you.
Not yet.
You shall never be of this coven!
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has accepted your request and taken you fully into [From.GetHerHis] dark coven.
Good.
Your sire [From.GetFirstName] has denied your request. The same blood runs in your veins, but you are not yet recognised as part of the coven.
My time will come...
Your sire [From.GetFirstName] has denied your request. The same blood runs in your veins, but you are not recognised as part of the coven, and if it is up to [From.GetHerHim], you never will be.
My time will come... one way or another...

Unlife has its blessings, but living under the thumb of your sire, [Root.Father.GetTitledFirstName], is not one of them. Centuries of slights and indignities have worn your patience thin, and at last your resentment boils over.

Unlife has its blessings, but living under the thumb of your sire, [Root.Mother.GetTitledFirstName], is not one of them. Centuries of slights and indignities have worn your patience thin, and at last your resentment boils over.
I owe my sire nothing more.
As the ages pass, you feel ever closer to your sire. You owe your eternity to your maker, and you wish to give eternal love in return.
Forever yours.
Over decades of unlife you have forged an unbreakable bond with your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]. Yours will be an eternal love.
Forever.
You can no longer hold back. Your feelings for your beloved have grown too strong to bear being apart. You must be one with your mate, forever.
Come to me...
[From.GetFirstName]'s love for you has grown until [From.GetSheHe] can no longer bear to be without you. Forsaking all reason, your lover falls upon you to take you into [From.GetHerHim] forever.
*Let [From.GetHerHim]*
*Cast [From.GetHerHim] out*
Your lover will devour you.
You weep with joy as you consume [From.GetFirstName]. Soon it is done, and you are one with [From.GetHerHim] forever. Never again will you feel alone, longing for [From.GetHerHis] embrace.
One, forever.
[From.GetFirstName] has rejected your love. You were wrong: [From.GetSheHe] never cared for you, and deserves nothing from you now but contempt.
So be it.

For centuries you have waited in the shadow of Drakenhof, wearing the face of a mortal count. That time is over. The Elector Counts squabble over a broken crown, and no Emperor sits in Altdorf. Your great spell is spoken, and the graveyards of Sylvania answer: the dead claw their way out of the earth in their thousands and stand in ranks before your castle, waiting for your word. Ostermark lies first on the road west. Let those who would not serve you in life serve you in death.
To war! Bechafen first.
No. I will strike where I choose.

Riders come in from the east, grey-faced and half mad. In Sylvania a vampire lord calling himself Vlad von Carstein has torn the dead from their graves, and an army of corpses marches on Ostermark. The priests of Morr ring their bells day and night. The Empire is divided, and it may not survive a war like this.

Traders bring a strange tale from the far side of the Old World. In the cursed land of Sylvania a vampire named Vlad von Carstein has raised the dead in their thousands and makes war on the fractured Empire. The tellers swear it is true. Perhaps the men of Sigmar will finally have a war they cannot win.
Morr protect us.
Let the Empire bleed.

Ostermark is yours, and its dead march in your ranks. West lies Talabecland and the crater-city of Talabheim behind its ring of cliffs. Take it, and the heart of the Empire is open to you. You raise fresh dead for the road.

Talabheim has fallen. Hochland lies north of the Talabec, a land of hunters and forests whose lords are weaker than the great seats further west. Break them now, before you march on the old capitals. You raise fresh dead for the road.

Your realm stretches from the Worlds Edge Mountains to the Drakwald. Now you turn on Middenland and the City of the White Wolf itself. Middenheim has never fallen to siege. Ulric's priests will learn what a siege by the dead is like. You raise fresh dead for the road.
Middenland kneels. Ostland guards your northern flank, and Wolfenburg's soldiers could strike at your back while you march west. Crush them first. You raise fresh dead for the road.

Your host keeps growing with every battle, the fallen of each side rising to join it. Nordland and Salzenmund are all that stand between you and the cold sea. Take the coast, and no Elector can come at you from the north. You raise fresh dead for the road.

The north is yours. Westerland and the rich city of Marienburg remain, its merchants and their mercenaries the last strength on the Reik before Altdorf. Take the river mouth and starve the capital. You raise fresh dead for the road.

Only the Reikland is left. Altdorf, the city of Sigmar, waits behind its walls with its Grand Theogonist and its frightened Electors. Throw it down, and the Empire of Man ends and the Empire of the dead begins. You raise fresh dead for the last march.
Victory is inevitable.
No. I will choose my own road.

Word comes that Vlad von Carstein is dead, truly dead this time. Across the east the dead he raised drop where they stand, armies of corpses collapsing into heaps of bone in the middle of the march. The bells of Morr ring again, in thanks this time. There may be hope for the Empire yet.

Vlad von Carstein is dead, and this time there will be no rising. In the same hour his great host fell apart, tens of thousands of corpses dropping into the mud with nothing to hold them up. It is a terrible blow. Without his dead, his heirs will have to hold the realm with blood and steel alone.
Sigmar be praised!
Damnation.

Rumours reach your realm that the von Carstein ring, which made its wearer unkillable, has been destroyed. Whoever holds the crown of Sylvania now can die like any other monster. There is hope that the dead can be stopped.
Excellent.
Risen Again

The blow should have ended you. Your body lay broken, your blood spilled in the mud. And then the ring on your finger burned, and dead flesh knitted, and bone set, and you rose. It is an agony no living thing could bear, but your enemies have no answer to it.

The ring drags you back from death, as it always does. You rise, broken bones grinding into place, and find that your get did not wait long to mourn. Some of the vampires of your court have already pressed their claim to your crown, and whisper about who will lead your armies now.
Damnation, that hurt.
Foolish children. I. WILL. NOT. BE. REPLACED!

[vamp_invader.GetTitledName] has ravaged the lands of [target_title.GetName], and its broken soldiers have nowhere left to go. State troops without a lord, militia without a village, outriders whose families now march in the ranks of the dead: they come to you in their hundreds, asking for bread and a chance to fight back against the hordes of undeath.
I shall make use of them.
Send them on. I cannot feed them.

To [Root.GetTitledName],

I, [From.GetTitledFirstName] [From.GetOnlyDynastyName], come to you in good faith, which is more than your priests would offer me. My host stands at your border.
